title: A second provider drops in through config only; the same flow serves both
asA: operator wiring the project against a second identity provider
iWant: adding the second provider to be a config-record write with no change to the flow-controller or session-bridge code
soThat: the provider abstraction promise the blueprint makes is real, not aspirational

acceptanceCriteria.description: A round-trip against a second mock OIDC provider added purely by extending the provider-config list issues a project session whose Principal carries the second provider's id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider from US-10101 plus a second mock OIDC provider added to the provider-config module with a distinct `id`, `issuer`, and JWKS; no code change to the flow controller or session-bridge modules
acceptanceCriteria.when: a browser dispatches `GET /auth/sign-in?provider=<second-id>` and completes the round-trip
acceptanceCriteria.then: the resulting session's `request.auth.provider` equals the second provider's `id`; `principalId` is derived under the second provider's slug and does not collide with any principalId issued against the first provider even when the underlying `sub` claim value is identical; the flow controller's request log records the redirect and the token exchange against the second provider's URLs, not the first

acceptanceCriteria.description: A sign-in request whose `provider` query parameter names an id not in the provider-config list is refused before any redirect.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN`; no `Location` header pointing at an authorise endpoint is emitted; no pending-flow record is written
